_about: Public-domain J. M. Cramp, Baptist minister and president of Acadia College, Nova Scotia, for the Word Hoard: A Text-Book of Popery, The Council of Trent, The History of the Reformation in Europe, a memoir of William Knibb, Scripture and Tradition with its appendix, and his addresses and sermons in Canada. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 124 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

cramp-text-book-popery: A text-book of popery; comprising a brief history of the Council of Trent, a translation of its doctrinal decrees, and copious extracts from the catechism published by its authority; with notes and illustrations: to which is added, in an appendix, the doctrinal decrees, and canons of the Council of Trent, in Latin, as published at Rome, anno Domini 1564: the whole intended to furnish a correct and complete view of the theological system of popery (New York, D. Appleton, 1831)
cramp-council-of-trent: The Council of Trent : comprising an account of the proceedings of that assembly; and illustrating the spirit and tendency of popery (London : Religious Tract Society, sold at the Depository, [etc.], 1839)
cramp-reformation: The history of the Reformation in Europe : with a chronology of the Reformation (London : Religious Tract Society ; New-York : Robert Carter, 1844)
cramp-knibb: A brief memoir of the Rev. William Knibb, late missionary in Jamaica : with an appendix, containing a sketch of the history of the Baptist Missionary Society ([Montréal? : s.n.], 1846)
cramp-1800-and-1850: 1800 and 1850 : a lecture delivered before the Montreal Mechanics' Institute on Tuesday evening, January 8, 1850 ([Montreal? : s.n.], 1850)
cramp-inaugural: The inaugural address, delivered by the president, June 20, 1851, and his introductory lecture to the theological course, delivered Sept. 23, 1851 : with an appendix containing a history of the college, the acts of incorporation, etc. etc ([Halifax, N.S.? : s.n.], 1851)
cramp-future-of-baptists: The "Future" of the Baptists and their duty to prepare for it : a lecture delivered at Wolfville, N.S., March 25th, 1852 ([Halifax, N.S.? : s.n.], 1852)
cramp-liquor-law: Prohibitory liquor law : the substance of an address delivered during the sitting of the Provincial Temperance Convention, in the Temperance Hall, Halifax, on the 23rd February, 1854 : the members of the House of Assembly and of the Legislative Council being present by invitation ([Halifax, N.S.? : s.n.], 1854)
cramp-scripture-tradition: Scripture and tradition : a reply to Mr. Maturin's letter on "The claims of the Catholic Church" ([Halifax, N.S.? : s.n.], 1859)
cramp-scripture-tradition-appendix: Appendix to Scripture and tradition : a reply to Mr. Manturin's letter on "The claims of the Catholic Church" ([Halifax, N.S.? : s.n.], 1859)
cramp-martyrs: The succession of matryrs : a sermon preached before the Central Baptist Association of Nova Scotia, at its ninth annual session, held with the church in Granville Street, Halifax, June 20, 1859 ([Halifax, N.S.? : s.n.], 1859)
cramp-wicked: What will become of the wicked? : an address (Halifax, N.S. : Christian Messenger Office, 1860)
cramp-nova-scotia-centenary: Centenary of the Baptists in Nova Scotia : A discourse delivered at Hillsburgh, June 10, 1860 (Halifax, : printed at the "Christian Messenger" office, 1860)
